flow.lore: A short note before the block.

creature.name: Glyph Scribe
entries: The scribe writes @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.abcdef123456]{Fireball} and [[/r 2d6]] in the margins, and a roll of [[/r 1d20 + 5]] on a table. See &Reference[Grappled] for the rule.
The scribe makes two Quill attacks.
Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

Each creature in a 15-foot cone must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) acid damage. Cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.abcdef123456]{Fireball} at them, or call [[/r 2d6]] fire damage and [[/damage 1d8 fire]] more.

paras: While you hold this quill you can write @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.items.Item.xyz]{Scroll} and [[/r 1d4]] notes that fade at dawn.
